mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, a strong labor market boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in RSAFS below $350,000 million signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in RSAFS decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 2% YoY, inflation concerns drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: positive UNRATE momentum (3-month moving average > 0) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during UNRATE positive momentum periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST above 700,000 units signals overextended housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle regimes.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during late-cycle regimes.
